### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/driver-memory`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **19** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`, `packages/core/src/utils/temporal-comparand.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/index.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/index.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/lifecycle.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class), storageDatetimeValue (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via SqlDriver (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/core/src/index.ts`, `packages/core/src/utils/temporal-comparand.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **153** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **153**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **98** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **36** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0bd11261efd82e05fa09a574ff86ab9a0c6ce33a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `09280c4db87471940fa14a5048f5747df2b63ba2` — the merge of head `b48f417154e71e5b4f7ca9059a3b46785be94e15` into base `0bd11261efd82e05fa09a574ff86ab9a0c6ce33a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 09280c4db87471940fa14a5048f5747df2b63ba2 && git checkout 09280c4db87471940fa14a5048f5747df2b63ba2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0bd11261efd82e05fa09a574ff86ab9a0c6ce33a b48f417154e71e5b4f7ca9059a3b46785be94e15 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0bd11261efd82e05fa09a574ff86ab9a0c6ce33a && git merge --no-ff b48f417154e71e5b4f7ca9059a3b46785be94e15

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0bd11261efd82e05fa09a574ff86ab9a0c6ce33a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0bd11261efd82e05fa09a574ff86ab9a0c6ce33a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b48f417154e71e5b4f7ca9059a3b46785be94e15`

Scope: PR #20202, 15 files (+1179/−227), card #20176. Base = merge base with `origin/main` = `560b724c95` (the branch's own merge of `main`); the 7 merged commits `cfe2387a3b..560b724c95` touch 40 files, ∩ PR files = ∅ (verified). `packages/spec` untouched; no governed surface. Detached worktrees of `560b724c95` and `b48f417154`, each `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + `turbo build --force` over the rest/objectql/metadata-protocol/driver-memory/driver-sql closure. Own harness (not the dev's scratch): real `InMemoryDriver`, real `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3 `:memory:` AND a private live PostgreSQL 16.13 (server zone Asia/Shanghai), through `engine.aggregate` / `engine.find` and `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` (`RestServer` → `findData`, JSON round-tripped body), populated (6 rows, 3 groups) and empty; per-aggregation `filter` beside its `where` twin (aggregate verb + `find`), `having` on both doors (native `driver.aggregate` and the forced in-memory fallback), grouped and ungrouped. 3983 cells/tree on memory+sqlite, 5859 with PG. Read: card + 4 comments, PR body, diff, #20148/PR #20174, #20127, ADR-0053 D-D, AGENTS.md, contract-review.md, landing-operations.md (all from `origin/main`).

### ① Derived judgments
- **Rows 1–8 + control (measured, base → head = `where` twin, identical on memory / sqlite / pg, engine and REST; every empty-object cell 0 / `[]` both trees):** r1 1→3=3 · r2 0→2=2 · r3 2→3=3 · r4 2→3=3 · r5 0→3=3 · r6 `$gte`/`$lt`/`$eq` 1/5/0→3/3/2=3/3/2 · r7 0→3=3 · r8 `having` ISO `$gte` on `max(date)` c2→c2,c3 (both doors) · control 4→4=4. Rows 6/7 at base equal the card's readings (PR #20174 did not move them).
- **Family sample (all head per-aggregation cells == `where` twin, per cell):** date: `$ne` 6→4, implicit 0→2, `$in` 0→3, `$nin` 6→3, `$between` 3→4, `$lt` 5→3, `Date` `$in`/`$nin`/`$between` 0→2/6→4/3→4; datetime: bare-day `$between` both 1→2, epoch string 6→3, epoch `$lte` 0→3, `$eq` 0→1, offset `$gte` 3→4, `$eq` 0→1, zone-naive T `$eq` 0→1, no-ms `$eq`/`$ne`/`$nin` 0→1/6→5/6→5, `$gt`+`$lte` 1→2, bare-day `$lte` beside `$lt` 3→4; time: ISO `$gt` 0→3, `$eq` 0→1, `11:00` `$eq`/`$lte`/`$in`/`$between` 0→1/2→3/0→2/2→3, `.000` `$eq` 0→1, bare day `$lte` 6→0 (no widening on `time`), `Date` implicit 0→1; `created_at`: `{today}` token `$lte` 0→6=6, `{today}` `$gte` 6=6, bare-day-today `$lte` 0→6, offset-today `$gte` 6; `$or`/`$not`/`$and` 1→3/5→3/0→2. Shapes whose head cell ≠ twin: exactly 2, both identical base→head and pre-existing: `$field` numeric pair on driver-memory (memory `where` never resolves `$field`), and an epoch-ms NUMBER on a `date` field (per-agg 0 both trees; `where` memory 0 / sqlite 6 / **pg `DATABASE_ERROR` 500**) — the seat's out-of-scope finding 2.
- **`having` (25 shapes × both doors × 3 drivers × engine/REST), every moved cell = the column's storage-rule answer:** ISO `$eq` `max(date)` []→c2 · ISO `$lt` `min(date)` c1,c2→c2 · ISO `$in` []→c2,c3 · `$nin`/`$ne` c1,c2,c3→c1,c3 · `Date` 10:00 `$gte` `max(date)` c2→c2,c3 · bare day `$lte` / `$between`-max on `min(datetime)` c1→c1,c2 (whole day) · epoch `$gte` []→c2,c3 · offset `$gte` c3→c2,c3 · `14:00` `$eq` `max(time)` []→c3 · ISO `$gte` `max(time)` []→c2,c3 · `Date` `$gte` `max(time)` []→c2,c3 · groupBy `date` col ISO `$gte` [03-01]→[02-01,03-01] · groupBy `datetime` col bare-day `$lte` +02-01T10:00Z · day bucket ISO `$gte` +2026-02-01 · day bucket bare-day `$lte` unchanged (date class) · controls (zone-naive, numeric, count, epoch-on-sum, month text bucket, date/date `addDays`) unchanged.
- **One rule:** `temporalStorageForm(value, kind)` in `packages/core/src/utils/temporal-storage-form.ts`, exported via core index; `driver-memory` `coerceTemporalValue` → it (3 module copies deleted); `driver-sql` `canonicalUtcDatetime` / `toDateOnly` / `canonicalTimeOfDay` → it, `temporalFilterValue` → `coerceFilterValue` → those; `checkCondition` → it. Third-copy scan (the rule's regexes / UTC getters) over the four packages' non-test src: none besides the yes/no predicate mirror in `temporal-comparand.ts` (pre-existing, named in Acceptance notes). `driver-mongodb` keeps its own copy (outside the claim, declared).
- **⚠️ Deviation measured (write + read paths):** 452 entries, **0 differ base→head** — raw stored bytes (SQLite file DB via a second better-sqlite3 handle incl. `typeof`; live PG `::text` + `pg_typeof`; memory store), `engine.find` and `driver.find` returned values, the `update` path, write errors, `formatInput` bind values and `temporalFilterValue` comparands (incl. lists) on better-sqlite3 / pg / mysql2 clients (seeded, no connection), across 21 spellings (ISO ±ms, offset, zone-naive space/T/µs, bare day, epoch number/string/negative, `Date`, `09:00`, `.5`, `.000`, padded, null, junk, empty, `25:00`, Invalid Date, NaN, bool) × datetime/date/time. **MySQL literal spelling** measured client-side only (`2026-02-01 10:00:00.250`, identical); MySQL server-side stored bytes **NOT MEASURED** (no server).
- **`where` byte identity:** 2916 `where` cells (aggregate + `find`, engine + REST, memory/sqlite/pg, P+E) identical base→head.
- **No collateral:** 822 refusal cells (PR #20174's, #20122's, #20123's, #20127's, #20099's) identical; moved cells not on a temporal per-aggregation/`having` position: **0**; row-5 `datetime` `Date` shapes keep PR #20174's answers (`$gt` 4, `$ne` 5, `$between` 3, `$in` 1, `$lte` midnight 2); `applyInMemoryAggregation` with 3 args: 231 cells identical.
- **Pins discriminate:** un-ablated head pins 84/84 objectql, 13/13 REST (+59 driver-memory, 10 driver-sql, 52 core). Ablation `temporalKindOf(classes?.get(key))` → `undefined` in `matchesHaving` (blob `77400359cc` → `7a2f5b7f14`, anchor 1→0), objectql rebuilt: **58 failed | 26 passed (84)**, REST **11 failed | 2 passed (13)** — the dev's counts; my harness in that state reproduced the base table 3983/3983. Restored `git checkout HEAD --`: blob = HEAD, `git status` clean, rebuilt, 84/13 green.
- **Scope/merge:** `packages/spec` untouched; `where` doors untouched (`temporal-comparand-door.ts` not in the diff; engine `where` seam unchanged); `git merge-tree --write-tree` of head onto `origin/main` `0bd11261ef`: clean, tree `845a115396`, no conflicts.
- **Changesets / PR body, sentence by sentence:** `20176-*` every sentence TRUE at head. `20148-*` DELIBERATE CORRECTION: old "Two readings still differ from a `where`, because the per-row comparison holds no declaration:" → new "Two readings still differed from a `where` in this change alone, because the per-row comparison held no declaration (#20176 closes both in the same release, reading every temporal comparand at this position by the column's storage rule):" — **TRUE at head** (row 6 → 3/3/2, row 7 → 3 = twin); `--numstat` `1 1`, every other line byte-identical. Other pending notes (`20148-keys-rest`, `20127-*`, `20099-*`, `20122-*`, `20123-*`, driver temporal notes) each describe their own change; none reads FALSE at head. PR body: one **FALSE** sentence — "No other line moved." (driver-sql): the import line (`nextUtcCalendarDay, temporalStorageForm`) and one JSDoc line in `toDateOnly` also changed; no code line beyond the three bodies. Loose, not false: "the three private copies are deleted" — they were module `export function`s of `memory-temporal.ts`, never re-exported by the package index.

### ② Semver level
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is **right**: new `@objectstack/core` index export `temporalStorageForm`; optional 4th parameter on the published `applyInMemoryAggregation` (objectql index). No narrowing arm needed: no request that answered is now refused (822 refusal cells identical), `having-filter.ts` is not re-exported, the deleted driver-memory functions were unreachable from the package `exports` map. Every moved answer is a count / kept-group correction toward the `where` (or the column's storage-rule) answer — the PR #20174 precedent — so no BREAKING banner / ADR-0087 marker is owed.
- Changeset `core` minor, `objectql` minor, `driver-sql` patch, `driver-memory` patch — consistent with the declaration and with the byte-identical driver measurement.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base 560b724c95 --event event.json` (current body, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`), exit 0: "✓ This diff introduces no `major` bump. ✓ LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes (widening)`, and it grades a package whose `packages/**/src/**` it moves at `minor` or above — the declared widening is accounted for: - @objectstack/core: minor - @objectstack/objectql: minor … These packages the diff also moves are graded `patch`, and are NOT refused: - @objectstack/driver-sql: patch - @objectstack/driver-memory: patch … · declaration line: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` · direction arm: `widening`".
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base 560b724c95`, exit 0: "✓ check-adr-0087-registration: this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (2 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)."
- **CI at head (all 41 check runs completed):** 34 success, 5 skipped, 2 failure — both `Check Changeset` (runs 36306880549 and 36307296621, the second re-triggered by the body edit). All seven required contexts `success`: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build Core, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Governed Surface Queue Guard. `Check Changeset` log reason (by design, exactly one file): "##[error].changeset/20148-aggregation-filter-where-doors.md exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR … DELIBERATE CORRECTION -- your change may have made this PENDING release note false, and you rewrote it in the same stroke. Remedy: do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed". No other failure.

### ③ Boundary flags
- Open question 1 → **B confirmed**: the body's `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the correct declaration; the claim's `no` was wrong.
- Open question 2 → **A confirmed**: the `20148-*` correction is TRUE at head, one line, rest byte-identical; this record is the same-head confirmation the gate asks for.
- Deviation "normalisation in `checkCondition`, not the loop": accepted — measured that `{today}` tokens resolve before the rule (token `$lte` on `created_at` 0→6 = twin).
- Deviation "`in-memory-aggregation.ts` threads the filter class map": accepted — 3-arg call byte-identical (231 cells).
- ⚠️ Deviation "driver re-pointing serves write/read": accepted — 452 write/read/bind/comparand entries identical on memory, SQLite, live PG and the three clients; MySQL server NOT MEASURED.
- Out-of-scope 1 (bare day as `time` upper bound, drivers disagree): recorded under the #5499 freeze; not measured here (the fixture has no midnight row).
- Out-of-scope 2 (epoch-ms number on a `date` field): confirmed memory 0 / sqlite 6 over `where`, and **live PG answers `DATABASE_ERROR` 500 over REST** — a third public-door answer for the seat's separate card.
- Prose nit, non-blocking: "No other line moved." in the PR body (see ①).
